verdict.rationale: Sandbox or test environments are a fair axis for an accounting SaaS with planned API and MCP access, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a sandbox or test mode that isolates users from production data. The accounting API and MCP layer are only announced as coming 'soon', and the probes found no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
